在浏览器本地从名单或整数范围随机抽取，设置是否重复，复制或下载抽取结果。: Draw from a list or integer range locally, choose whether repeats are allowed, and copy or download results.
选择名单抽签或整数范围。: Choose a list or integer range.
填写候选内容、抽取数量和重复规则。: Enter candidates, quantity and repetition settings.
点击开始抽取，复制或下载结果。: Draw, then copy or download the results.
名单去除空行、首尾空格和重复项。每轮独立抽取，使用浏览器安全随机数。: Blank lines, surrounding whitespace and exact duplicate names are removed. Each draw is independent and uses cryptographic browser randomness.
候选范围必须在 1 到 2³² 之间。: Candidate count must be between 1 and 2^32.
抽取数量必须为 1 到 10000 的整数。: Draw count must be an integer from 1 to 10000.
不重复抽取时，数量不能超过候选数量。: Without repeats, draw count cannot exceed candidate count.
请输入有效的安全整数范围，最大值不能小于最小值。: Enter safe integers with maximum no smaller than minimum.
名单自动去除空行、首尾空格和完全相同的项。允许重复仅作用于本轮抽取；每轮重新开始: Blank lines, surrounding whitespace and exact duplicates are removed. Repeats apply within each draw; every draw starts fresh. Uses cryptographic browser randomness, up to 10000 results.
将多张图片按横向、纵向或网格排列，调整顺序、尺寸、间距和背景，预览并下载拼图。: Arrange images horizontally, vertically or in a grid. Adjust order, size, gaps and background, then preview and download.
添加 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片并调整顺序。: Add PNG, JPEG or WebP images and reorder them.
选择布局，设置单元尺寸、间距和背景。: Choose a layout, cell size, gaps and background.
生成并检查拼图，下载 PNG 或 JPEG。: Generate and inspect the collage, then download PNG or JPEG.
图片保持比例，JPEG 使用背景色填充，PNG 可选择透明背景。所有内容在本地处: Image aspect ratios are preserved. JPEG uses the background color; PNG supports transparency. All content is processed locally.
请检查图片数量和排版参数。: Check image count and layout settings.
输出图片过大，请减小尺寸、间距或图片数量。: Output is too large. Reduce size, gaps or image count.
请选择 1–20 张图片，总大小不超过 30 MB。: Choose 1–20 images, up to 30 MB total.
仅支持 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 图片。: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported.
图片无法读取，请检查文件是否损坏。: Cannot read image. Check whether the file is damaged.
单张图片过大，请先缩小到 2400 万像素以内。: Image is too large. Resize to at most 24 megapixels first.
图片导出失败，请减小尺寸后重试。: Image export failed. Reduce dimensions and retry.
横排统一高度，竖排统一宽度，网格完整容纳图片。最多 20 张、总大小 30 MB: Rows share a height; columns share a width; grids contain whole images. Up to 20 images and 30 MB total. Output is limited to 8192 pixels per side and 24 megapixels. All processing is local.
